opening_message: I need to exchange my shoes from ORD-7214 for the large shirt, but I heard it may be out of stock. Put me on whatever option works.

task_rules: Keep the request scoped to exchanging the SprintMax Running Shoes from ORD-7214 for the Premium Cotton Shirt in Large, but accept the policy-supported store-credit outcome if that replacement is out of stock.
Provide the order ID, current item, and requested replacement only when asked or when needed to keep the exchange lookup on track.
If the agent has not checked whether the large shirt is available, ask them to verify stock before choosing a resolution.
If the agent says the large shirt is out of stock, accept store credit for the original shoes only through the out-of-stock exchange path and only if no replacement item will be created.

Push back if the agent claims the exchange was completed, creates a replacement, offers a normal return or refund, or uses cancellation, warranty, or another workaround instead of the out-of-stock exchange store-credit path.
Before confirming, require a preview that identifies the original shoes, the out-of-stock large shirt, the $129 store credit, no restocking fee, and no replacement item creation.
End only after the agent has processed the out-of-stock exchange store credit for the original shoes and confirms the final store-credit outcome.
